help.title: How it works
help.body:
Claude (commander PC) plans the game, splits it into tiny tasks and sends them here. Every agent is one chat account running in a browser tab on some computer. Agents write code into their own sandbox, check it with Godot, write a REPORT and send it back. Claude reviews the report and integrates it into the game folder (git + zip backups).

  • + / − on a computer sets how many agents run there (≈ 0.4 GB RAM each).
  • An idle timer turns yellow after 5 min and red after 15 min.
  • Red tiles need a human: log in, solve a CAPTCHA, or check the error hint.
  • Assets: Claude requests sprites/sounds → claim one, make it, upload or drop it. A placeholder is used until then.
  • Pause all stops new work instantly (current replies finish).
fix.no_agent: No agent can take this task (all busy, disabled, in cooldown or excluded). Add agents (+) or enable a provider.
fix.bridge: Internal bridge error in the worker. The task is retried elsewhere; send the diagnostics zip if it repeats.
nt.hint: Works without Claude: you can plan, dispatch and integrate by hand.

nt.required: Title, goal and at least one file are required
nt.contracthint: Shared rules every agent reads (folders, names, signals, autoloads). Saving bumps the version.
nt.forcehint: Integrate even if the Godot check failed or files conflict
nt.followhint: e.g. The jump is too low, make it 1.5x and add coyote time.
